card.name: Start of ex- and over- words meaning excess
card.fires_on: The first piece of words that start with ex- or over- and mean 'too much' or 'from outside', such as exogenous, excess, excessive and overdosage. It is most active at the start of a sentence or after 'the' in dosing and hormone text.

modes.label: Exogenous
modes.description: The ex- start of 'exogenous' before hormone, amines or corticosteroids.
modes.example: 131I uptake is determined before and after the administration of the<< ex>>ogenous hormone.

modes.label: Excess or overdose
modes.description: The start of excess, excessive or overdosage at the beginning of a sentence about too much drug.
modes.example: Do not exceed the recommended dosage.<< Ex>>cessive use of STIOLTO RESP

card.writes: It pushes the model toward finishing the word with 'excess', 'excessive' or 'surplus' meanings, including in Chinese.
card.plain: It marks the opening of words like exogenous, excess and overdose, which talk about too much of something.
